title: Easy Anti-Cheat was unable to verify Fortnite
desc: Fix verification errors, file integrity checks and when to use Account Recovery after EAC issues.

body.text: “Easy Anti-Cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Fortnite launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck EAC modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
What the error means
“Easy Anti-Cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Fortnite launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck EAC modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
Work through verification fixes before assuming HWID enforcement or buying [HWID Spoofer](/products/fortnite-cheats/hwid-spoofer/).
Verify game files on Epic
Epic Games Launcher → Library → Fortnite → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity. Let the scan finish completely.
Restart Epic as administrator once. Retry launch before any cheat loader runs—vanilla pass confirms client health.
Restart EAC and PC cold boot
Exit Epic fully—including tray icon. Cold reboot (full power off, not fast restart). Relaunch Epic, wait for cloud sync, then Fortnite.
EAC modules sometimes stick after Windows sleep—cold boot clears stuck modules without reinstall.
Remove conflicting software
Disable overlay injectors, old cheat remnants, and kernel debug tools temporarily. Uninstall unused VPN kernel drivers.
Run Fortnite vanilla once to confirm EAC passes—then follow [external cheat guide](/blog/fortnite-external-cheat-guide/) for clean loader order.
When it is an actual ban
Persistent verify failure on every account after clean reinstall may indicate account restriction. Check Epic profile ban status.
[Account Recovery](/products/fortnite-cheats/ugc/) helps structured appeal workflows—not instant unban guarantees. HWID spoof does not fix verify errors from corrupt files.
Loader order after fix
Once Fortnite launches clean, read [EAC patch day checklist](/blog/eac-patch-day-checklist/) before enabling [private fortnite cheats](/products/fortnite-cheats/).
Launch external loader before Fortnite per portal guide—reversed order can re-trigger verify on some builds.
After fix: safe return to cheats
Discord support wants verify-error screenshots plus order email if loader fails post-fix. Do not rage-queue Ranked same hour as verify fix—run bot lobby ESP check first.
Conservative presets after any EAC-related error—telemetry spikes after client repairs.
